contentPattern.structure: full-width dark band: award badge image beside a heading + supporting paragraph (no CTA)

suitableFor: full-width dark brand/award banners with a badge image beside heading + text
recognition / accolade strips ('Best X for N years') with no call-to-action
edge-to-edge dark promotional bands emphasising a single message + badge
notSuitableFor: coloured callout promos that include a CTA (use hero-callout)
full-bleed photo hero at the top of the page (use hero-promo)

usage.notes: Admiral homepage awards banner (custom-banner dark-blue): 'Personal Finance Awards 2025/26 Best Motor Insurance' badge beside heading 'May the Best Motor Insurer win... oh wait, that's us again!' and a supporting paragraph. Dark full-bleed band, no CTA.
